messages:
Zoe: quick heads-up from onboarding: node sampleapp with OTEL_AUTO_INIT=1 produced DEBUG spam and retries had different request ids. customer confused.
Harpreet: can you paste a tiny log fragment?
Zoe: ```
INFO  auth: token fetched
DEBUG http: req_id=orig-123 -> POST /v1/chat
WARN  http: 401 from /v1/chat
DEBUG http: req_id=retry-456 -> retry POST /v1/chat
```
Zoe: also the user message had an inline code secret like `api_key: `sk_prod_zzz`` and later DEBUG line printed the raw block.
Luis: two issues: (1) retry layer regenerates request id instead of reusing original, (2) otel autoinit toggles levels before our redaction middleware runs.
Harpreet: for (1) we should prefer ctx.requestId when building retry attempts and copy it into X-Request-Id header for each try. small change in retry-sender.
Luis: agreed. add unit test that asserts same X-Request-Id across attempts and the trace/span ids stay constant.
Harpreet: for (2) mitigation options: a) register redaction as an earliest sync pre-hook, b) add a logging.Filter that redacts at emit-time as a last-resort, c) make OTEL_AUTO_INIT not flip global log levels by default.
Zoe: i prefer b + c. Filter ensures secrets never escape even if middleware ordering is wrong; plus make autoinit conservative.
Luis: parity note: java already has an emit-time filter; node/python missing it. add to SDK parity backlog and tests.
Harpreet: filing ticket DX-1603 and a tiny repro in sampleapp. will include e2e matrix entries: OTEL_AUTO_INIT={0,1} and OTEL_EXPORTER_DEBUG={0,1} across node/python/java.
ci-bot: created branch telemetry/reqid-redact-filter and queued CI for sampleapp (unit + telemetry-e2e).
devx-bot: ticket DX-1603 created: "preserve-request-id-on-retry + emit-time redaction filter + otel-autoinit conservative defaults"; linked PR #734.
Zoe: i'll add a one-line note to onboarding: "If you see unexpected DEBUG logs set OTEL_AUTO_INIT=0 while you finish setup." saves support churn.
Luis: once PR lands, cut a patch and announce in #onboarding and #eng-runtime.
Harpreet: assigning PR to @Luis for review.
Zoe: thanks y'all. small fix but avoids leaking secrets during demos. :thumbsup:
